## md5() function

Calculate the MD5 hash of value WARNING: MD5 is cryptographically broken. 不可用于口令哈希或签名 (do NOT use for password hashing or signatures). Use bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 for passwords and HMAC-SHA256 for signatures.
